color.note: Ember is the dark glass UI from the video with a vermilion-orange primary. Ink keeps the same structure on frosted light glass with a near-black primary; orange survives only as the accent.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind every glass panel. Text on it: text, text-muted, text-subtle.

tokens.name: bg-wash
tokens.usage: Soft lighter wash painted over bg in the top-left of a page, standing in for the blurred photo behind the glass.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Default panel fill (GlassCard, sidebar) over bg. Always paired with border and a backdrop blur.

tokens.name: glass-raised
tokens.usage: Panel that sits above another panel: sidebar, secondary buttons, chips.

tokens.name: glass-inset
tokens.usage: Recessed fill inside a panel: stat tiles, input fields, segmented-control track.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Near-opaque fill for Modal, Drawer, DropdownMenu, Popover, Toast and CommandPalette so text keeps full contrast over any page.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for ghost buttons, menu items and nav items.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Selected fill for neutral segmented controls and the active command-palette row.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind Modal, Drawer and CommandPalette.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline around panels, cards and overlays. Decorative: never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Boundary of interactive controls (inputs, selects, switch and slider tracks, outline buttons). Holds 3:1 on glass and overlay surfaces in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers on bg, glass, glass-raised and surface-overlay.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and helper copy on bg, glass, glass-raised and surface-overlay.

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: eyebrow labels, axis ticks, placeholders. Smallest text allowed; on bg, glass and surface-overlay.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only. Exempt from contrast by WCAG; never use for content that must be read.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand fill: primary Button, active NavItem, selected SegmentedControl item, on Switch, Slider fill. Ember theme: vermilion orange. Ink theme: near-black.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for primary surfaces.

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed fill for primary surfaces.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary, primary-hover and primary-pressed. Also the Slider and Switch thumb.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background for a primary-coloured icon tile or a selected row.

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: Brand colour used as text or icon on glass and overlay surfaces (links, active icons, chart labels).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Second highlight: gauge arcs, secondary chart series, the target pill. Ember: amber. Ink: orange, so the oranges survive as an accent.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind accent text, as in the 'target 5.5%' badge.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Gains, success, 'let', yield-up numbers and bars. Use with a word or arrow, never colour alone.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind positive badges and toast icons.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs-attention text and bars (letting agent's cut, empty weeks).

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind warning badges and toast icons.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Late payments, errors, destructive actions. Pair with an alert icon or the word 'Late'.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind danger badges, toast icons and error fields.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral information and the fourth segment of stacked bars.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind info badges and toast icons.

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: Tooltip fill. Always reversed from the page.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on inverse.

tokens.name: avatar-cream
tokens.usage: Avatar fill in both themes; initials use on-cream.

tokens.name: on-cream
tokens.usage: Initials on avatar-cream.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, drawn as a 2px outline with a 2px offset. At least 3:1 on bg, glass and overlay in both themes.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First data series: the main line, the largest stacked segment.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second series.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third series and neutral bars.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth series.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Fifth series.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: Hero numbers on a panel. Tabular figures.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Modal and Drawer titles, section headings.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Dense UI text: list rows, menu items, field values.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Helper text, badges, chips, axis labels.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Button, nav item and tab labels.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase group labels in the sidebar and menus.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudges, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a control, between a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; nav item padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel gutter between stacked tiles; input padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Default panel padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between panels; modal padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter, section gap.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Large page margins, empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Kbd, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Menu items, nav items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, inset tiles, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: GlassCard, sidebar.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Modal, Drawer, CommandPalette.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, badges, chips, segmented controls, switches.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Resting GlassCard: a lit top edge plus a soft drop.

tokens.name: shadow-primary
tokens.usage: Primary Button, active NavItem.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: DropdownMenu, Popover, Tooltip.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modal, Drawer, CommandPalette, Toast.

tokens.name: blur-sm
tokens.usage: Scrim and tooltip backdrop.

tokens.name: blur-md
tokens.usage: Glass panels.

tokens.name: blur-lg
tokens.usage: Modal, Drawer and CommandPalette surfaces.

tokens.name: z-menu
tokens.usage: DropdownMenu, Popover.

tokens.name: z-layer
tokens.usage: Modal, Drawer, CommandPalette.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toast region.

tokens.name: z-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltip: always on top.
